formulas.formula: Know what you pay for. Cancel what you don't use.
Subscriptions: list every one. Price, how often it bills and the date it renews (any past renewal date works).
Status: Active, Free trial, Paused or Cancelled. Only Active and Free trial count toward your costs.
Uses a month: be honest. It shows your cost per use.
Decision: Keep, Maybe or Cancel. The Audit tab adds up what you'd save.
Renewals: what's coming up next, in date order. Trials ending soon are flagged.
Type any past renewal date. The sheet works out the next one.
Add the trial end date so you get a heads-up before you're charged.
Often cheaper. The sheet shows the true monthly cost.
Search your bank for 'subscription' to find forgotten ones.
Red = renews or ends very soon.

=IF(R4=0,"Add your subscriptions on the Subscriptions tab.",IF(R9>0,R9&IF(R9=1," free trial ends"," free trials end")&" within a week. Decide now!",IF(R10>0,"Cancel what you marked and keep "&TEXT(R10,"$#,##0")&" a year.","You pay "&TEXT(R6,"$#,##0")&" a year. Every one earns its keep.")))
Renews on: any past or upcoming renewal date. Next renewal rolls forward on its own.
="Coming up after "&TEXT('Setup'!$R$5,"mmm d, yyyy")&". Active subscriptions and free trials, soonest first."
